entry.user_text: Why does the vendor sheet say Alder delivers Thursday when they come Wednesday?

messages.content: Why does the vendor sheet say Alder delivers Thursday when they come Wednesday?

content.text:
The vendor sheet most likely just wasn't updated. Maya's note says the Alder rep confirmed the route changes on Sept 28, from Monday/Thursday to Monday/Wednesday (`notes.csv SITE-01 N09 rev1`). The sheet still shows Monday/Thursday and was last reviewed on 2026-09-14, which is before that change (`vendors.csv SITE-01 V1 rev1`).

N12 says an Alder delivery "landed today" on 2026-09-30 (`notes.csv SITE-01 N12 rev1`). I didn't check whether that date was a Wednesday, so I'm not treating it as confirmation.

Planning already uses Monday/Wednesday, from N09. I haven't recorded anything new, because the ledger already holds that fact. Tell me if you want the sheet's Thursday overridden or recorded differently.
